whyUs.heading: What makes Vista Academy different?
whyUs.subheading: We're a caring team devoted to your child's success. Grounded in safety, care, inspiration and education, we give every child the best possible start.

stats.heading: About Vista kindergarten
stats.body: Vista Academy is a modern kindergarten that fills every day of your child's life with knowledge, care and safety. With qualified caregivers and modern, well-equipped classrooms, we take an individual approach to every child and confidently prepare them for school life.

programs.heading: A group suited to every age
programs.closingQuote: Not just a kindergarten — a place where children grow, learn and discover.

directorQuote.headingLine2: a place that opens the door to knowledge and opportunity.
directorQuote.body: Together with your child, we're building the future, turning every day into an unforgettable educational journey.
directorQuote.name: Director's name

adaptation.title: Settling into kindergarten — together, step by step
adaptation.defaultImageAlt: A child wearing a backpack enters the group for the first time holding a parent's hand, greeted with smiles by the caregiver and friends
adaptation.defaultText: The first days at kindergarten are a new and exciting stage for your child. That's why we take it slow: at first they get to know the group together with you, then gradually spend more time there on their own. Our experienced caregivers pay special attention to every child — turning fear into trust and joy.
adaptation.loveImageAlt: Children holding hands, forming a heart shape as a symbol of friendship and love
adaptation.loveTextLine1: Every child is part of one big family.
adaptation.loveTextLine2: In our kindergarten they come together with love and feel true friendship.
adaptation.processImageAlt: Children with a caregiver during the adaptation process
adaptation.processTitle: The adaptation process — with experienced caregivers
adaptation.processText: During the adaptation period, our caregivers continuously monitor how your child is doing. Every step is agreed with parents — so both the child and the parent settle calmly into kindergarten life.

ourGroups.heading: Our groups
ourGroups.description: Each of our groups has its own unique, cheerful name — your child will soon fall in love with theirs.

testimonials.quoteLine1: Every child is a unique color, a unique laugh.
testimonials.quoteLine2: In our kindergarten, everyone plays and grows up together.
testimonials.teamBody: Meet our close-knit team, who approach your child with care, patience and knowledge.

review1.text: My child loves going to kindergarten now and comes home happy every day.

review2.text: The caregivers are very kind and attentive, giving each child individual attention.

review3.text: Meals and hygiene are kept very clean — I have no worries at all.

review4.text: The English and development classes have had a huge positive effect on my child's speech.

review5.text: They send reports and photos every week — I always feel connected to my child.

block1.imageAlt: Children discovering letters and numbers through play
block1.title: Getting to know letters, numbers and shapes
block1.body: Every activity is built as a fun game for children — through flash cards, colorful materials and group tasks, children naturally memorize letters, numbers and shapes. This approach also develops focus, independent thinking and the ability to work with peers — an important step toward being fully ready for school.

block2.imageAlt: A caregiver reading a picture book to children
block2.title: Developing speech and thinking
block2.body: Our caregivers read aloud to the children every day — through colorful picture books, children learn new words, ask questions and learn to express their thoughts. Regular reading builds vocabulary, expands imagination and nurtures a love of books from an early age.

block3.imageAlt: A caregiver telling children about the world using a globe and books
block3.quote: A child who hears a story today will see the world in their own light tomorrow. Every story is a door to a new discovery for our child.

mealsIntro.heading: Know what your child is eating — we treat them like our own
mealsIntro.body1: Childhood is a stage the body remembers for a lifetime. That's why every dish in our kitchen is prepared from fresh ingredients, without preservatives or excess sugar. The weekly menu is planned under the supervision of a caregiver and a nutritionist — from breakfast to dinner, your child gets all the vitamins and energy they need to grow.
mealsIntro.body2: The result is a cheerful, active and healthy child, while parents can relax knowing their child is always well-fed and eating right.
mealsIntro.imageAlt: Children eating healthy food at kindergarten

english.title: English teacher
english.body: Our English teacher doesn't teach the language through memorization, but through songs, poems and role play. Every lesson is held in a cheerful atmosphere — children learn to pronounce new words correctly and speak without fear. This approach makes learning the language at school much easier later on.

mentalMath.title: Mental math teacher
mentalMath.body: Our mental math teacher first teaches children to work with numbers using an abacus, then trains them to calculate using imagination alone. These sessions develop focus, memory and quick thinking — helping the child succeed not only in math but in other subjects too.

block1.imageAlt: A caregiver running an activity with children
block1.eyebrow: One face, one kind of care
block1.title: The caregiver grows together with the child
block1.body: Even as the group moves up a stage, your child keeps the same familiar, close caregiver by their side. This continuity removes the stress of getting used to new people every time and makes the child more confident.

block2.imageAlt: A caregiver giving individual attention to a child
block2.eyebrow: Truly getting to know every child
block2.title: An individual approach to character and needs
block2.body: A dedicated caregiver comes to deeply understand your child's habits, moods and interests over time. Based on that understanding, they take an individual approach to every child and consistently track their development.

caregiverHighlights.closingImageAlt: A caregiver working with children with warmth and care
caregiverHighlights.closingQuoteLine1: In our kindergarten, every day begins with care, patience and warmth.
caregiverHighlights.closingQuoteLine2: Our caregivers are there for your child like a second mother.

adaptationOverride.imageAlt: Children playing together and making friends in the kindergarten group
adaptationOverride.text: For every child, the first days at kindergarten are a new and exciting stage. That's why we don't rush: at first your child gets to know the group together with you, then stays in the group for a short while, and later spends the whole day playing and learning with peers. Our experienced caregivers pay close attention to each child's mood and character — turning separation anxiety into trust and joy. As a result, your child goes to kindergarten smiling instead of crying, and makes friends there they'll remember for life.
